sample.details:
$5 tournament fee ($25 entry to location for the day)
Tournament starts at 6pm, runs until approx 9pm.
There will be THREE rounds of THREE games. Total of 9 games played per player.
Players will be grouped into fours and if necessary groups of threes.
In each round a group plays a single game on three different machines and allocated points according to their finishing position (7/5/3/1 or 7/4/1 depending on number of players in the group).
At the end of the 3 rounds, players are ranked from highest to lowest points.
